llms.body:
# ACTIVE.com

> ACTIVE.com is an event discovery, registration, and active lifestyle platform connecting people with races, sports, activities, training resources, expert editorial content, and fitness tools.

ACTIVE.com helps athletes and active consumers discover and register for events including running races, triathlons, cycling events, youth sports, leagues, camps, fitness activities, and other recreational events.

ACTIVE.com also publishes expert content covering training, fitness, sports nutrition, health, injury prevention, recovery, sports gear, product reviews, and active living. Editorial content is written by subject-matter experts and incorporates professional review, fact-checking, and community product testing where applicable.

For event organizers, ACTIVE provides registration, race management, and event management technology.

## Core ACTIVE Resources

- [Browse All Events](https://www.active.com/browse): Discover races, sports, leagues, camps, fitness activities, and local events across categories and locations.
- [Running](https://www.active.com/running): Running events, race discovery, training resources, and expert running guidance.
- [Triathlon](https://www.active.com/triathlon): Triathlon events, training guidance, race preparation, and expert content for triathletes.
- [Cycling](https://www.active.com/cycling): Cycling events, training resources, riding guidance, and expert content for cyclists.
- [Fitness](https://www.active.com/fitness): Fitness activities, workouts, training guidance, wellness resources, and fitness tools.
- [Nutrition](https://www.active.com/nutrition): Expert content covering sports nutrition, fueling, meal preparation, recipes, and supplements.
- [Product Reviews](https://www.active.com/health-and-injury/product-reviews): Expert reviews and testing of running shoes, fitness equipment, apparel, outdoor gear, recovery products, and active lifestyle products.
- [ACTIVE for Kids](https://www.activekids.com): Youth sports, camps, classes, and family activity discovery and registration.

## Event Discovery & Registration

ACTIVE.com provides searchable event listings for races, endurance events, sports leagues, camps, classes, and recreational activities. Event listings may include dates, locations, distances, registration options, organizer information, and other event-specific details.

- [Browse All Events](https://www.active.com/browse): Search activities and events across categories and locations.
- [Running Events](https://www.active.com/running): Find running races and events across multiple distances and disciplines.
- [Triathlon Events](https://www.active.com/triathlon): Find triathlon events ranging from beginner races to long-distance events.
- [Cycling Events](https://www.active.com/cycling): Find road cycling, mountain biking, recreational rides, and endurance cycling events.
- [Fitness Events](https://www.active.com/fitness): Find fitness activities including yoga, walking, strength training, and other fitness events.
- [Outdoor Events](https://www.active.com/outdoors): Find hiking, camping, and outdoor recreation activities.

## Running

ACTIVE.com provides running event discovery, training guidance, race preparation, expert advice, and resources for runners ranging from beginners to endurance athletes.

- [Running Events](https://www.active.com/running): Browse and register for running events of all distances.
- [Marathon Training](https://www.active.com/running/marathon): Marathon events, long-distance training, race preparation, and running guidance.
- [Half Marathon Training](https://www.active.com/running/half-marathon): Half marathon events, training, and race preparation.
- [10K Races & Training](https://www.active.com/running/10k): 10K event discovery and training resources.
- [5K Races & Training](https://www.active.com/running/5k): Beginner-friendly 5K events, training, and racing guidance.
- [Couch to 5K® Guide](https://www.active.com/running/couch-to-5k-guide): The official Couch to 5K® beginner running program guide.
- [Trail Running](https://www.active.com/running/trail-running): Trail running events, training advice, and resources.
- [Mud Runs](https://www.active.com/running/mud-running): Mud run and obstacle race events and guidance.
- [Ultra Running](https://www.active.com/running/ultra): Ultramarathon events, training, and endurance running resources.
- [Running Articles](https://www.active.com/running/articles): Expert editorial content covering running, training, racing, and performance.

## Triathlon

- [Triathlon Events](https://www.active.com/triathlon): Browse and register for triathlon events across race distances.
- [Triathlon Articles](https://www.active.com/triathlon/articles): Expert content covering triathlon training, racing, equipment, preparation, and performance.

## Cycling

- [Cycling Events](https://www.active.com/cycling): Browse road cycling, mountain biking, recreational, and endurance cycling events.
- [Mountain Biking](https://www.active.com/cycling/mountain-biking): Mountain biking events, training, and riding resources.
- [Cycling Articles](https://www.active.com/cycling/articles): Expert content covering cycling training, performance, equipment, and riding.

## Training & Performance

ACTIVE.com publishes practical training guidance for athletes and active consumers, including beginner programs, endurance training, strength and conditioning, and race preparation.

- [Marathon Training](https://www.active.com/running/marathon): Long-distance marathon training and race preparation guidance.
- [Half Marathon Training](https://www.active.com/running/half-marathon): Half marathon training and race preparation.
- [5K Training](https://www.active.com/running/5k): Beginner-friendly 5K training, preparation, and racing guidance.
- [Couch to 5K® Guide](https://www.active.com/running/couch-to-5k-guide): Beginner running program designed to help new runners progress toward completing a 5K.
- [Core & Ab Training](https://www.active.com/fitness/core-ab-training/articles): Core strength and conditioning guidance.
- [Injury Prevention](https://www.active.com/fitness/injury-prevention): Practical guidance for reducing sports and training injuries.

## Gear & Product Reviews

ACTIVE.com publishes editorial reviews, comparisons, and recommendations covering running, fitness, outdoor recreation, and active lifestyle products.

Product reviews are written by subject-matter experts and may incorporate hands-on testing, community tester feedback, professional review, product specifications, comparisons, and recommendations based on intended use.

- [Product Reviews](https://www.active.com/health-and-injury/product-reviews): Reviews of running shoes, fitness equipment, performance apparel, outdoor gear, wearables, recovery products, and other active lifestyle equipment.

## Fitness & Wellness

- [Fitness](https://www.active.com/fitness): Fitness activities, training resources, workouts, and active living guidance.
- [Fitness Articles](https://www.active.com/fitness/articles): Expert editorial content covering fitness, workouts, wellness, and active living.
- [Core & Ab Training](https://www.active.com/fitness/core-ab-training/articles): Core strength and conditioning guidance.
- [Weight Loss](https://www.active.com/fitness/weight-loss/articles): Fitness and lifestyle content focused on healthy weight management.

## Health, Recovery & Injury Prevention

ACTIVE.com publishes educational health and wellness content intended to help active people train, recover, and maintain an active lifestyle.

- [Health & Injury Articles](https://www.active.com/health-and-injury/articles): Expert content covering physical health, recovery, pain, sleep, injury, and mental wellness.
- [Injury Prevention](https://www.active.com/fitness/injury-prevention): Practical guidance for reducing common sports and training injuries.

## Nutrition

ACTIVE.com publishes sports nutrition content for athletes and active consumers, including guidance on fueling, hydration, meal preparation, recipes, supplements, and performance nutrition.

- [Nutrition Articles](https://www.active.com/nutrition): Expert content covering sports nutrition, meal preparation, recipes, fueling, hydration, and supplements.

## Team & Individual Sports

- [Soccer](https://www.active.com/soccer): Soccer events, leagues, programs, and training resources.
- [Basketball](https://www.active.com/basketball): Basketball events, leagues, programs, and training resources.
- [Swimming](https://www.active.com/swimming): Swimming events, meets, programs, and training content.
- [Tennis](https://www.active.com/tennis): Tennis events, programs, and training resources.
- [Baseball & Softball](https://www.active.com/baseball): Baseball and softball leagues, programs, and events.
- [Volleyball](https://www.active.com/volleyball): Volleyball events, leagues, programs, and training resources.
- [Golf](https://www.active.com/golf): Golf events and resources.
- [Martial Arts](https://www.active.com/martial-arts): Martial arts events and programs.
- [Winter Sports](https://www.active.com/winter-sports): Skiing, snowshoeing, and winter sports activities and events.
- [Sports Articles](https://www.active.com/sports/articles): Expert editorial content covering team and individual sports.

## Outdoor & Adventure

- [Outdoor Events](https://www.active.com/outdoors): Hiking, camping, and outdoor recreation activities and events.
- [Hiking](https://www.active.com/outdoors/Hiking): Hiking activities, events, and resources.
- [Camping](https://www.active.com/outdoors/camping): Camping activities and reservation resources.

## Youth Sports & Activities

- [ACTIVE for Kids](https://www.activekids.com): Discover and register for youth sports, camps, classes, and family activities.

## ACTIVE Challenges

ACTIVE Challenges are structured virtual fitness challenges designed around running, cycling, walking, and daily movement goals.

- [All Challenges](https://www.active.com/challenges): Browse and join virtual fitness challenges.
- [Running Challenges](https://www.active.com/running/challenges): Virtual running challenges featuring mileage and participation goals.
- [Cycling Challenges](https://www.active.com/cycling/challenges): Virtual cycling challenges featuring distance and participation goals.
- [Step Challenges](https://www.active.com/steps/challenges): Step-count challenges focused on everyday fitness and movement.

## Fitness Tools & Calculators

ACTIVE.com provides interactive calculators to help athletes and active consumers understand training pace, energy needs, heart rate, and other fitness metrics. Calculator results are estimates and should be interpreted alongside the explanatory guidance provided on each page.

- [Running Pace Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/pace): Calculate running pace, finish time, or distance.
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmi): Estimate body mass index with usage guidance and context.
- [Kids' BMI Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmi-kids): BMI calculator designed for children.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/calories): Estimate daily calorie requirements.
- [Heart Rate Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/heartrate): Estimate target heart rate training zones.
- [BMR Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr): Estimate basal metabolic rate.
- [Body Fat Percentage Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bodyfat): Estimate body fat percentage.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/weight): Estimate ideal weight ranges with supporting context.
- [Nutritional Needs Calculator](https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/nutrition): Estimate macronutrient and nutritional requirements for active individuals.

## Race Results

- [Race Results](https://resultscui.active.com): Search race and event results available through ACTIVE, including participant results, finishing times, divisions, rankings, and related event result information where available.

## ACTIVE Mobile Apps

ACTIVE offers mobile applications supporting event discovery, beginner running programs, race training, and competitive event results.

- [ACTIVE Mobile Apps](https://www.active.com/mobile): Overview of ACTIVE's mobile app ecosystem.
- [Couch to 5K® App](https://www.active.com/mobile/couch-to-5k-app): ACTIVE's beginner running application based on the Couch to 5K® program.
- [Meet Mobile App](https://www.active.com/mobile/meet-mobile-app): Live results, heat sheets, and event information for swimming and track meets.
- [5K to 10K App](https://www.active.com/mobile/5k-to-10k-app): Training application for runners progressing from 5K to 10K.

## ACTIVE Advantage Membership

ACTIVE Advantage is ACTIVE's premium membership program providing benefits related to event registration, sports, gear, travel, and active living.

- [ACTIVE Advantage](https://advantage.active.com/home): Overview of ACTIVE Advantage membership.
- [Membership Benefits](https://advantage.active.com/benefits): Current ACTIVE Advantage membership benefits, savings, and partner offers.
- [Join ACTIVE Advantage](https://advantage.active.com/join/full): Current membership and trial options.
- [Membership FAQ](https://advantage.active.com/faq.htm): Information about membership, billing, cancellation, benefits, and redemption.

## Event Organizer Solutions

ACTIVE provides technology and services for organizations managing races, sports programs, camps, classes, leagues, and other events.

- [Race Director Software](https://www.active.com/race-director-software): Registration and race management technology for endurance event organizers.
- [Registration Software](https://www.active.com/registration-software): Online registration tools for sports leagues, camps, events, and programs.
- [Organizer Account Access](https://www.activeendurance.com/event-organizer): Access for organizers managing events using ACTIVE.
- [Advertise With ACTIVE](https://www.activenetwork.com/lp/advertise-with-active): Advertising and sponsorship opportunities across the ACTIVE audience.

## ACTIVE Ecosystem

ACTIVE.com is the consumer event discovery, registration, and editorial platform within the broader ACTIVE Network ecosystem.

Related services include ActiveKids.com for youth sports and activities, ACTIVE Advantage for membership benefits, ACTIVE Endurance for event organizer services, ACTIVE mobile applications, and ACTIVE's developer platform for accessing event data.

- [About ACTIVE](https://www.active.com/about): Background on ACTIVE.com, its audience, and mission.
- [ACTIVE for Kids](https://www.activekids.com): Youth sports, camps, classes, and family activity platform.
- [ACTIVE Advantage](https://advantage.active.com/home): Membership program providing benefits for active consumers.
- [ACTIVE Developer API](https://developer.active.com): Developer resources and APIs for integrating with ACTIVE event data.

## Developer Resources

- [ACTIVE Developer API](https://developer.active.com): API documentation and resources for developers using ACTIVE event data.

## About ACTIVE

- [About ACTIVE](https://www.active.com/about): Background on ACTIVE.com, its audience, platform, and mission.
- [Affiliate Program](https://www.active.com/affiliate): Information about ACTIVE's affiliate and partner program.

## Help, Support & Policies

- [Help and Support](https://support.activenetwork.com/usersupport): Support for ACTIVE accounts, registrations, payments, and related questions.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.activenetwork.com/terms-of-use.htm): Legal terms governing use of ACTIVE services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.activenetwork.com/information/privacy-policy): Information about how ACTIVE Network collects, uses, and handles personal information.
- [Privacy Settings](https://www.active.com/privacy-settings): Manage communication and data privacy preferences.
- [Careers](https://careers.activenetwork.com): Career opportunities at ACTIVE Network.
